action:
This update uses a new upstream release, which includes additional bug
fixes. After a standard system update you need to restart any running Java
applications to make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that the Security component of OpenJDK 11 did not
correctly authenticate users. A remote attacker could possibly use this
issue to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-83374)

It was discovered that the JSSE component of OpenJDK 11 did not correctly
authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to modify
sensitive data. (CVE-2026-83376, CVE-2026-91461)

sensitive data. (CVE-2026-83380)
